name: ui-components
tagline: Web Components for TUI and browser from one Rust definition
description: ui-components is a Rust project that defines UI components once and renders them both as ratatui terminal apps and as Lit Element web components. It aims to bridge the desktop-terminal and browser worlds so a single component definition can power identical UIs in both environments. Cross-rendering from one source of truth removes the duplication that usually exists between CLI and web frontends. It is a compelling experiment in unified, cross-surface UI development.
highlights: One component definition renders as both a TUI and a web component
Bridges ratatui terminal apps and Lit Element web components
Removes duplication between CLI and web frontends
Written in Rust with a unified source of truth
curatorNote: Terminal and web UIs are usually maintained as two completely separate codebases. Rendering both from one Rust definition is a genuinely interesting answer to that duplication problem.
